Popover.use: titled overlay with a built-in close action

Popup.use: bare anchored surface for custom content

placement.block-end: opens below the trigger, the default reading direction for most panels
placement.block-start: opens above the trigger when the space below is tight
placement.inline-start: opens toward the start edge, alongside the trigger
placement.inline-end: opens toward the end edge, alongside the trigger

rules.choice: Use Popover for a labeled panel with its own title, description and close action. Use Popup when the content brings its own semantics and only needs an anchored surface.
rules.arrow: Enable arrow only when the trigger needs a visible pointer back to it; it is decorative and never announced.
